hotels.description: Set beside Shellharbour Marina on the NSW South Coast, this contemporary waterfront retreat places The Waterfront dining precinct and the Shell Cove boardwalk just steps away. The Links Shell Cove golf course and the patrolled sands of Shellharbour South Beach are both within easy reach. Inside, a sleek restaurant and bar pairs marina views with modern Australian dining, while the outdoor pool and fitness centre bring a polished resort feel. Nearby, Bass Point Reserve offers coastal walks and diving spots, and Killalea Regional Park is known for its rolling headlands and surf beaches
